events.title: United States Marks 250 Years Since The Declaration Of Independence
events.summary: July 4, 2026, marked the 250th anniversary of the United States Declaration of Independence.
events.context: The National Archives framed the semiquincentennial around the Declaration of Independence and the country's long civic memory.
events.whyItMatters: The anniversary was a major national commemoration and a broad public-history moment in the United States.

events.detailMarkdown:
July 4, 2026, marked 250 years since the Declaration of Independence.

The anniversary gave July 2026 a major public-history frame in the United States, connecting civic ritual, archival memory, commemoration, and contemporary debate over the country's founding ideals.
